descripcion_geo: Narrow coastal plain of southern Asia Minor between Lycia and Cilicia. Perge was its main city.

historias.titulo: Juan Marcos abandons Paul in Pamfilia
historias.descripcion: In Perge of Pamphylia, John Mark leaves Paul and Barnabas and returns to Jerusalem; This abandonment will later cause the separation of Paul and Barnabas.

historias.titulo: Paul preaches in Perge of Pamphylia
historias.descripcion: Upon returning from the first voyage, Paul preaches in Perge before embarking.
Among those present at Pentecost are men from Pamphylia.

personajes.descripcion: He abandoned the mission in Pamphylia; He was later restored and wrote the second gospel.
He passed through Pamphylia twice on the first missionary journey.
He continued the trip after Juan Marcos abandoned him.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Pamphylia: relevant region in the NT world.

mitos.nombre: Pamphylia: land of abandonment and restoration

cristianismo.descripcion: John Mark abandoned the mission in Pamphylia; Paul later rejected him, but later Paul himself valued his service (2 Tim 4:11).
